Album description
Lamb Of God entered the scene at the turn of millennium with impetuosity, in a market that was not yet saturated, catching us all off guard. They were among the last Metal groups that I noticed before my tastes veered towards Indie-Rock and Jazz, a moment of personal transition that can be understood by finding out my age in the profile. Lamb Of God succeeded in their aim of unifying a rebellious youth in constant search of strong sensations and Ashes of the Wake still remains one of the great progenitors of modern metal.
